headline: An intimate Chinatown cocktail den
blurb: Low-lit, expertly mixed, and worth the squeeze — the kind of room you settle into for the whole night.

headline: Candlelit Italian, always a scene
blurb: Rustic pastas and wood-fired pizzas in one of the most romantic rooms downtown. Book ahead — it's packed for a reason.

headline: Chelsea's neighborhood happy hour
blurb: Friendly, unpretentious, and reliably good — a Chelsea standby with one of the better happy hours around.

headline: The city's best quick tacos
blurb: No frills, just blistered tortillas and standout al pastor — a perfect pre-show bite.

headline: Inventive small plates in NoHo
blurb: Creative, seasonal cooking that punches well above its block. Grab a counter seat and let them cook.

headline: A polished Midtown East pour
blurb: Sleek and grown-up — a calm refuge from the Midtown rush with a serious cocktail list.
